decisions.reason: The building data digital twin service still fits the firm’s strategic direction, but if another year has not lifted demand and visibility toward aspiration levels its more uncertain market profile makes it the most plausible candidate for withdrawal, so we would keep it under close review.

Authentication and identity delegation remain useful complements to enterprise GeoIT solutions, yet some overlap with adjacent identity offerings could trigger problemistic search and portfolio simplification if results stay below aspirations, so we would keep it for now.

The open GIS application development framework is strongly aligned with the firm’s platform-based solution business and likely supports multiple customer projects, so even with uncertain standalone returns management would keep it.

The GIS-specific identity and access service is a close functional fit with integrated GeoIT deployments and likely benefits from complementarities with the core offer, so we would retain it unless performance clearly disappoints relative to aspirations.

The geodata business process consulting workshop builds directly on existing consulting capabilities and can feed larger assignments, so despite being young and still unproven we would keep it while monitoring whether uptake reaches acceptable levels.
